internal.title: High Error Rate Alert on flagd Service - Incident Escalated
internal.body: At 12:10 UTC on 2026-11-08, a high error rate alert was triggered for the flagd service. Initial diagnosis rounds tested hypotheses including error injection, latency, and resource exhaustion on the frontend, but none were supported by the evidence gathered. Due to lack of conclusive evidence, the incident was escalated to the on-call engineer at 12:30 UTC for further investigation. No recovery or resolution was confirmed during this period.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience.
